title: Exact Banach-Mazur distances of certain $\ell_p$-sums and cones
summary: We determine certain Banach-Mazur distances involving $\ell_p$-direct sums of finite-dimensional real normed spaces and related cone constructions of convex bodies. Using a recent characterization of the optimal Banach-Mazur position with respect to the Euclidean ball, we derive a closed formula for the distance from $X_1 \oplus_p \cdots \oplus_p X_k$ to Euclidean space in terms of the distances of the spaces $X_i$ to Euclidean space. For $p = 1$ we show that if $d_{BM}(X,\ell_1^n) \leq 3$, then $d_{BM}(X \oplus_1 \ell_1^m, \ell_1^{n+m}) = d_{BM}(X,\ell_1^n)$. Interpreting $\ell_1$-sums…
